title: waggle: a 30-byte token that gives each subagent its own view of the plan
description:
Every multi-agent handoff is paste-and-hope: the whole plan into each subagent, no idea which one read it. waggle replaces that with a 30-byte token. Each subagent resolves it into its own view and greps the slice it needs, so the artifact never travels. Every read is counted, so you catch a subagent that bluffed before you trust it. Fix the plan, one revoke reaches all of them. It's MCP-native, one config line.

https://github.com/modiqo/waggle
